newsitem.title: PERU: Peru, Buenaventura/PanEnergy sign oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Peru, Buenaventura/PanEnergy sign oil contract.

text.p: The government said Wednesday it had signed a hydrocarbon contract with a consortium of Peru's Buenaventura Ingenieros SA and PanEnergy to explore and develop oil Block 85 in the central jungle.

The accord, published in the official daily El Peruano, is the 38th such contract state oil firm Perupetro has signed with private companies since 1993. No details about the block's size or estimated reserves were available.
The government has said it estimates its oil contracts require an average investment of around $40 million from the private firms.
